```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(xgboost)
  library(dplyr)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, ".."), mustWork = FALSE)

OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
XGB_DIR    <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs")
MODEL_DIR  <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models")
PRED_DIR   <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions")

run_name <- "xgBoost_loco_n1000_pgBoostFeatures_test"

data_file      <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data.tsv")
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files", "training_data_snppg_ALL_chr123.tsv.gz")
predictor_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictors.txt")

model_dir <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, run_name)
pred_dir  <- file.path(PRED_DIR,  run_name)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(pred_dir,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

feat_out <- file.path(model_dir, "feature_names.txt")
outfile  <- file.path(pred_dir, paste0(run_name, ".tsv"))
```

```{r}
full_data <- fread(data_file)
training_data <- fread(training_file)

diag_overlap_cols <- function(full_data, training_data,
                              cols = c("peak","gene","celltype","snp","chr")) {
  res <- rbindlist(lapply(cols, function(col) {
    fd_v <- full_data[[col]]
    td_v <- training_data[[col]]

    # NA counts (before coercion)
    na_full  <- sum(is.na(fd_v))
    na_train <- sum(is.na(td_v))

    # Deduplicate uniques (exclude NA for overlap calc)
    fd_dt <- unique(data.table(v = trimws(as.character(fd_v[!is.na(fd_v)]))))
    td_dt <- unique(data.table(v = trimws(as.character(td_v[!is.na(td_v)]))))
    setkey(fd_dt, v); setkey(td_dt, v)

    ov <- nrow(fintersect(fd_dt, td_dt))

    data.table(
      column        = col,
      full_unique   = nrow(fd_dt),
      train_unique  = nrow(td_dt),
      overlap       = ov,
      pct_of_full   = round(100 * ov / max(1, nrow(fd_dt)), 2),
      pct_of_train  = round(100 * ov / max(1, nrow(td_dt)), 2),
      na_full       = na_full,
      na_train      = na_train
    )
  }))
  print(res)
  invisible(res)
}

# Usage:
index_cols <- c("peak","gene","celltype","snp","chr")
diag_overlap_cols(full_data, training_data, cols = index_cols)

```

```{r}
ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",   # fuse IN → Neurons
  Ext = "Neurons",    # fuse Ext → Neurons
  End = "Endothelial"  
)

# apply mapping if key is present
training_data[, celltype := ifelse(celltype %in% names(ct_map), 
                                   ct_map[celltype], celltype)]

# Merge on full identity
index_cols <- c("peak", "gene", "celltype", "snp", "chr")
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# Labels: 1 = pos, 2 = strong neg -> make 0/1
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]

cat(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s\n", nrow(data)))
cat(sprintf("Number of positives: %s\n", sum(data$label == 1L)))
cat(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n\n", sum(data$label == 0L)))

# Predictors
predictors <- scan(predictor_file, what = character(), quiet = TRUE)
predictors <- c("snp_gene_distance", "closest_tss", "cicero", "scent", "signac")
pred_cols  <- intersect(predictors, names(data))
stopifnot(length(pred_cols) > 0)
cat(sprintf("Using %d features for model training and prediction.\n\n", length(pred_cols)))

```



```{r}
annotation_feature_tabb <- data[, pred_cols, with = FALSE]
labels <- data$label
LOO_colname <- "chr"
chromosomes <- sort(unique(data[[LOO_colname]]))

# save feature names once 
writeLines(colnames(annotation_feature_tabb), feat_out)

predictions <- data.frame()

for (chr in chromosomes) {
  cat(sprintf("Chromosome %s:\n", chr))

  # Off-chromosome
  train_idx <- data[[LOO_colname]] != chr
  X_train   <- as.matrix(annotation_feature_tabb[train_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  y_train   <- labels[train_idx]

  cat(sprintf("Number of training instances: %s\n", length(y_train)))
  cat(sprintf("Number of positives: %s\n", sum(y_train)))
  cat(sprintf("Number of negatives: %s\n", length(y_train) - sum(y_train)))

  # Train
  bst <- xgboost(
    data             = X_train,
    label            = y_train,
    max_depth        = 6,
    eta              = 0.05,
    gamma            = 10,
    min_child_weight = 6,
    subsample        = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 1.0,
    nrounds          = 1000,
    nthread          = 2,
    objective        = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric      = "auc",
    verbose          = 1
  )

  # Save this fold’s model
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("xgboost_loco_%s.model", chr))
  xgb.save(bst, model_path)

  # Predict on held-out chromosome
  pred_idx <- data[[LOO_colname]] == chr
  X_pred   <- as.matrix(annotation_feature_tabb[pred_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  p_hat    <- predict(bst, X_pred)

  chrom_predictions <- cbind(
    as.data.frame(data[pred_idx, ..index_cols]),
    xgBoost_probability = p_hat
  )
  predictions <- rbind(predictions, chrom_predictions)
  cat(sprintf("Number of scored links: %s\n\n", nrow(chrom_predictions)))
}

predictions <- predictions %>%
  mutate(xgBoost_percentile = percent_rank(xgBoost_probability))

write.table(predictions, outfile, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Total number of scored links: %s\n", nrow(predictions)))
cat(sprintf("Saved predictions to %s.\n", outfile))
```
